sources.title: Alan Turing: The Enigma
sources.author: Andrew Hodges
sources.notes: The standard scholarly biography; synthesizes archival material, correspondence, and colleague recollections. Precise page/chapter citations for individual claims in this dataset are not yet recorded and should be verified directly against the book in Phase 2.

sources.title: www.turing.org.uk (Alan Turing: the enigma -- companion site)
sources.author: Andrew Hodges
sources.notes: Reference companion site maintained by Turing's biographer; useful for cross-checking dates and details from S001.

sources.title: The Turing Digital Archive
sources.author: King's College, Cambridge
sources.notes: Digitized personal papers, correspondence, and manuscripts. Individual item/folio references are not yet recorded in this dataset and should be added when a specific document is cited.

sources.title: On Computable Numbers, with an Application to the Entscheidungsproblem
sources.author: A. M. Turing
sources.publisher: Proceedings of the London Mathematical Society, ser. 2, vol. 42
sources.notes: Turing's own published work; the foundational computability paper.

sources.title: Computing Machinery and Intelligence
sources.author: A. M. Turing
sources.notes: Turing's own published work; introduces the imitation game.

sources.title: The Chemical Basis of Morphogenesis
sources.author: A. M. Turing
sources.publisher: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B, vol. 237
sources.notes: Turing's own published work on reaction-diffusion pattern formation.

sources.title: Alan M. Turing
sources.author: Sara Turing
sources.date: 1959 (repr. 2012 with an afterword by Martin Davis)
sources.notes: Biographical memoir written by Turing's mother; a contemporary but personally invested source -- treat claims from it as CONTEMPORARY evidence, not neutral scholarship.

sources.title: The Essential Turing
sources.author: B. Jack Copeland (ed.)
sources.notes: Annotated collection of Turing's own papers and writings, with scholarly commentary by Copeland.

sources.title: Bletchley Park Trust / Bletchley Park Research
sources.author: Bletchley Park Trust
sources.notes: Museum and archival body for wartime Government Code and Cypher School operations at Bletchley Park.

sources.title: Government Code and Cypher School (GC&CS) records, HW series
sources.author: UK Government Code and Cypher School
sources.identifier: The National Archives, Kew -- series HW
sources.notes: Official wartime cryptanalysis records. This dataset currently cites the series generally; specific document references should be added in Phase 2.

sources.title: Pioneering Work on Computers at Bletchley
sources.author: I. J. Good
sources.publisher: in N. Metropolis, J. Howlett & G.-C. Rota (eds.), A History of Computing in the Twentieth Century, Academic Press
sources.notes: Personal recollection by a Bletchley Park (Hut 8 / Newmanry) colleague of Turing's.

sources.title: Turing: Pioneer of the Information Age
sources.author: B. Jack Copeland
sources.notes: Scholarly biography; notably argues the standard suicide verdict for Turing's death is not conclusively established by the surviving evidence -- used here specifically as a contested, minority-position scholarly claim, not a settled fact.

sources.title: Announcement of a Royal Pardon for Alan Turing under the Royal Prerogative of Mercy
sources.author: UK Government (Ministry of Justice)
sources.notes: Posthumous pardon for the 1952 conviction, following the 'Alan Turing law' campaign.
